jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

!! If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply !!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
At Llbg, our core business processes depend on seamless integrations between SAP, cloud applications, data platforms, customers and suppliers. As an Integration Engineer, you play a key role in designing, building and supporting the integrations and automations that connect these systems.

Working primarily with Workato, you help ensure our critical business processes run efficiently, reliably and securely. You combine technical expertise with a problem-solving mindset and contribute to scalable, future-proof solutions that support our continued growth and digital transformation.
Function

• You design, build, test, deploy and support enterprise integrations and process automations on the Workato platform.

• You translate business requirements into reliable and scalable integration solutions while adhering to Llbg's architecture and integration standards.

• You integrate SAP applications with many other business-critical systems such as Microsoft 365, cloud applications, data platforms and external B2B interfaces

• You monitor integration flows, handle incidents, perform root cause analyses and continuously improve solutions to ensure stable business operations.

• You develop and maintain reusable components, technical documentation, test scenarios and operational procedures that support long-term maintainability.

• You collaborate closely with architects, developers, business analysts and external partners to deliver scalable, sustainable and supportable solutions.

• You contribute to the further development of intelligent automation and AI-enabled solutions, ensuring they are secure, reliable and deliver measurable business value.

• You help drive continuous improvement of the integration platform by promoting best practices, identifying optimization opportunities and contributing to reusable standards and governance.

• As Integration Engineer you will report to the Integration Architect.

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering or a related field, or have gained equivalent experience.

• You have an affinity with, and basic understanding of integration concepts through study, internship, personal projects, or professional experience.

• Prior exposure to an iPaaS platform (Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite, Azure Integration Services) is a strong plus but not required.

• You have some familiarity with at least a few of the following, and are eager to deepen your knowledge on the job:

• Integration principles and patterns (sync/async communication, event-driven architecture)

• API technologies (REST, SOAP, GraphQL)

• Security concepts (authentication, authorization, API security)

• Data formats and transformation (JSON, XML, CSV, data mapping)

• Monitoring, logging, and error handling in system integrations

• You can communicate fluently in English and Dutch.

• You enjoy working with both technical and business stakeholders in an international environment.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Junior Data Engineer (Production & Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
As a Junior Data Engineer - Production & Supply Chain, you help transform operational data into reliable and actionable insights. You contribute to data products, data models, and data pipelines that support reporting, Power BI, Machine Learning, and AI applications.

Working with data from ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational systems, you learn how to structure, integrate, and make data accessible across the organization. Together with BI/RT Solution Partners, Data Scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders, you help build solutions that improve decision-making across production, planning, inventory, logistics, and quality.
Function

• You support the design, development, testing, and documentation of ETL/ELT data pipelines that transform operational data into reliable datasets for BI, analytics, Machine Learning, and AI.

• You contribute to the integration of data from production and supply chain systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational applications.

• You help build data products and semantic models covering topics such as production performance, forecasting, inventory management, Otif, planning, traceability, and logistics efficiency.

• You perform data quality checks, investigate data issues, and contribute to maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring, and data lineage.

• You learn and apply modern data engineering practices, including Version Control, testing, CI/CD, and DataOps.

• You work in an agile environment alongside data analysts, data scientists, IT colleagues, and business stakeholders, gradually developing into a well-rounded data professional.

You report directly to the Data & Analytics Platform Architect.

• You hold a Master's degree in IT, Data, Engineering, or a related field.

• You have gained relevant experience through internships, academic projects, or an initial professional experience.

• You have a solid foundation in SQL and Python and are eager to further develop your expertise in modern cloud data platforms such as Azure and Databricks.

• You are interested in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, testing, and documentation. Experience with DBT or similar frameworks is considered a plus.

• You are analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how high-quality data supports better decision-making.

• You are comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently, accelerate learning, and support innovative solutions.

• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Knowledge of Dutch a plus.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - IT Workplace Engineer m365
jobs.description:
As IT Workplace Engineer M365, you become part of the IT Workplace team and help shape and continuously improve our modern workplace ecosystem.

You play a key role in managing and evolving four core domains: Identity, Microsoft 365 Collaboration, EndPoint Management, and Workplace Security & Operations.

This role is ideal for an experienced Microsoft 365 professional who wants to contribute to a modern enterprise workplace and enjoys combining technical depth with governance, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Function

• You manage and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Conditional Access and identity governance processes to ensure secure and reliable access management.

• You own and further develop the Microsoft 365 collaboration environment, including SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams and related services.

• You own the SharePoint Online platform, including tenant configuration and site provisioning, and work closely with the Information & Knowledge Architect to ensure a structured and effective information architecture.

• You administer and optimize Microsoft Intune for device management, compliance, application deployment and EndPoint lifecycle management.

• You manage the Power Platform tenant and collaborate closely with the Workplace Intelligent Automation Engineer to enable secure, scalable and well-governed automation solutions.

• You contribute to workplace automation, standardization and operational excellence across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

• You maintain workplace security controls, including EndPoint hardening, patch management and vulnerability remediation.

• You act as a second- and third-line escalation point for complex Microsoft 365 and workplace-related issues.

• You collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects and IT colleagues to continuously improve the employee digital workplace experience.

• You contribute to platform governance, operational standards, documentation, runbooks and best practices across the Workplace domain.

• After 6 months, you will join the on-call rotation, maximum 1 week/month.

• As an IT Workplace Engineer M365 you will report to the IT Workplace Manager.

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Applied Informatics, Computer Science or a related field and have at least five years of experience as an IT Workplace Engineer M365 or in a comparable function within an international organisation.

• You have strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and identity & access management, and understand how to build secure and scalable workplace environments.

• You have hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 technologies such as SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Intune and the Power Platform, and are familiar with governance and lifecycle management best practices.

• You have a solid understanding of workplace security, including Zero Trust principles, EndPoint management, vulnerability remediation and Microsoft security solutions.

• Experience with PowerShell scripting and Microsoft Copilot governance is a strong asset.

• You are analytical, customer-focused and eager to drive continuous improvement.

• You communicate effectively in Dutch and English. A good working knowledge of French is a plus.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Information & Knowledge Architect
jobs.description:
At Llbg, we believe that high-quality information is the foundation of better decisions, efficient collaboration, and successful AI adoption. As our Information & Knowledge Architect, you will define how information is structured, governed, and managed across the organization.

You will create the frameworks, standards, and governance models that transform data and content into trusted business knowledge. Working closely with architects, platform owners, and business stakeholders, you will ensure that information is accessible, reliable, compliant, and ready to power future AI-driven solutions. This is a strategic, hands-on role where architecture, governance, technology, and change management come together.
Function

• You define and own Llbg's information and knowledge architecture, including domain models, business glossaries, taxonomies, metadata standards, and semantic frameworks that create a shared understanding across systems, countries, and teams.

• You establish and drive our information governance framework, ensuring clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards, classification, retention, and lifecycle management for both structured and unstructured information.

• You lead master data governance by defining business object ownership, stewardship responsibilities, standards, and governance processes together with key stakeholders.

• You define how information is created, tagged, classified, versioned, stored, and retired, ensuring that content remains trusted, compliant, and ready to support AI-driven use cases.

• You collaborate closely with architects and platform owners to design and implement information models within governance and Microsoft 365 platforms.

• You establish the governance principles and guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge, ensuring compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal policies.

• You lead by building. For the first AI Knowledge use cases, you are directly involved in the design and delivery, shaping the content model, retrieval logic, grounding approach, evaluation framework, and adoption journey. By leading these initial implementations, you establish the standards, best practices, and reusable templates that future teams can build upon rather than reinvent

• You engage with business stakeholders across the organization to identify, prioritize, and deliver knowledge management and AI-related initiatives that support Llbg's digital transformation journey.

• You lead and coach the AI Knowledge Engineer while driving adoption, change management, and knowledge stewardship across multiple countries and business domains.

• You hold a Master's degree in Information Science, Data Management, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a related field.

• You bring 8-12 years of experience combining information governance, data governance, and hands-on technical implementation.

• You have successfully designed and implemented taxonomies, metadata models, semantic structures, or governance frameworks that delivered measurable business value.

• You have experience with master data governance in ERP-driven environments; SAP experience is a strong advantage.

• You have the practical capability to build knowledge AI solutions yourself, from preparing and structuring source content to designing enterprise search and RAG-based experiences.

• You understand the technical and operational work behind successful AI adoption, including metadata, retrieval quality, access controls, testing, user feedback, and long-term ownership

• You are familiar with governance and catalog solutions such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, or similar platforms, and communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.
